heroSubtitle: Suites, storefronts and stockrooms moved on Pasadena building schedules, Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM

faq.question: Do we need a parking permit for an office move in Pasadena?
faq.answer: On most commercial streets, reserving the curb is the only workable option. The city's Parking Office sells Temporary No Parking signs, and you book the spaces for the full loading window; yellow loading curbs are off limits because Pasadena keeps moving trucks out of commercial loading zones. After the walkthrough we tell you how many spaces to request.

faq.question: Can you move our suite at a South Lake Avenue office campus on a weekday?
faq.answer: That depends on the building's own rules, so we read them first. At Pasarroyo the freight elevator cannot be reserved during business hours, and weekday moves are limited to early-morning and evening windows that fall outside our 8AM – 6PM day. There we book a Saturday instead and file the building's forms two weeks ahead.

faq.question: Do you move offices overnight or on Sundays?
faq.answer: SOS crews are on the job Monday to Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so a large office moves in daytime phases rather than in one overnight push. Pasadena lets moving trucks stand at the curb only from 7 am to 7 pm, which is one more reason each phase starts and ends within a single day. Sunday is open on our side, although some buildings, Pasarroyo among them, close their docks that day.

faq.question: How much does an office move in Pasadena cost?
faq.answer: Pasadena office jobs are hourly: a two-mover crew and truck runs $119 cash or $129 card from Monday to Thursday, and bigger crews or Friday-to-Sunday dates cost more, as the price list above shows. Every job has a 3-hour minimum, and a COI for your building is $50. The walkthrough sets the crew size and truck count, which drive the total.

faq.question: Are there dates to avoid for a business move in Pasadena?
faq.answer: Check the Rose Parade closures first: for the 2018 parade the city shut the route from 10 pm on December 31 and towed cars left in No Parking areas, so for an address near the route we read that season's city notice before booking. Major Rose Bowl events can close downtown streets too, as Holly Street was on 2025 FIFA Club World Cup match days, so we check city advisories before we confirm.

faq.question: Can you move our stockroom or warehouse items with the office?
faq.answer: Yes. Pallets, loaded shelving and heavy shop equipment go as a separate phase on machine dollies, so the office crew is never waiting on them. Mention them at the walkthrough so the right crew size and truck are scheduled.
